build_GalileoObserve_logger: build a GalileoObserve custom logger instance to stream LLM call telemetry to Galileo
create_LLMResponse_record: create an LLMResponse pydantic model with latency, tokens, input and output text fields
run_async_log_success_event: run async_log_success_event to capture and flush a successful LLM call to Galileo Observe
run_flush_in_memory_records: run flush_in_memory_records to POST buffered LLM records to Galileo ingest API
review_set_galileo_headers: review set_galileo_headers to authenticate and store Bearer token for Galileo API requests
